question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right midfielder, Bob is playing left back, and Claire is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Finally, Bob and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) right midfielder
(B) left back
(C) goalkeeper
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: right midfielder, left back, goalkeeper
1. Claire ↔ Alice: goalkeeper, left back, right midfielder
2. Claire ↔ Alice: right midfielder, left back, goalkeeper
3. Bob ↔ Alice: left back, right midfielder, goalkeeper
Alice is playing left back, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
